title: mixcore core API v0.2: StateListener.OnState(stateJSON)
description: A snapshot replaces everything the UI holds; a diff lists changes since the previous message. seq grows by one per message; a gap never happens within one Start. Values are the console's, never the UI's. events report holds that ended without the user releasing them; they appear in snapshots and diffs and are never dropped by coalescing (up to 256 between two messages).

status.description: live: input unlocked. stale: connection lost (no packet from the console for 1.5 s, or the console stopped answering), last values shown, Apply returns ERR_STALE. connecting: not yet connected since Start/Resume. stopped: Stop or Pause. status, reason, staleSinceMs, offline (and the v0.1 connection fields below) describe the connection in every message, snapshot or diff; an absent optional field means false or none.

reason.description: Diagnostic text for logs, never shown to users as is.

staleSinceMs.description: v0.1. Present only while status is stale: when the connection was lost, as Unix time in milliseconds (wall clock of this device). The UI counts up from it ('Reconnecting 0:07'). It does not move while reconnect attempts fail; it disappears when the status leaves stale.

limited.description: v0.1. True while the console accepts this engine but does not send it updates because its remote client slots are full (design SR-17, CR-10; x32: four push clients; xair: eight). Values may be stale and are shown as such; Apply returns ERR_STALE and every hold is cancelled (holdCancelled, reason limited) although status stays live. It clears by itself as soon as an update arrives; a Pause and Resume retries. There is no polling fallback (CR-15 is unverified). Absent means false.

limitedReason.description: v0.1. Present with limited: the evidence. noEchoOfOwnWrites: three writes that changed a value got no confirmation while the console answered. rereadFoundUnpushedChanges: two background re-reads in a row found values that changed without an update.

offline.description: v0.1. True once status has been stale for 30 s (design 8.1 'Offline', a stronger label only: the core keeps retrying at the same pace). Absent means false.

strips.description: snapshot only: inputs in order, then main.

muteGroups.description: v0.1: mute groups this strip belongs to. v0.2: absent on a strip that has no mute-group membership on its console (xair: main).

dcas.description: v0.1: DCA groups this strip belongs to (inputs only on x32 and xair).

absentInputs.description: v0.2, snapshot only, xair: input strips the family documents (16, XA-F71) that this mixer did not answer when the engine first connected (a small model, or a link too lossy to probe, XA-F72). They stay absent until Stop and Start; strips that answered once are never dropped on a reconnect. Absent when every documented input answered. UI: 'Inputs 13-16 not found on this mixer'.

changes.description: diff only; present (possibly empty) in every diff. v0.1: when a mute, a group state or a membership changes, the core also lists every strip whose effectiveMute changed, as field effectiveMute with the origin of the change that caused it.

oneOf.description: The desk, a scene recall or another client changed a parameter this client was holding. The console's value is already in state (in changes, or in the snapshot). The gesture has ended: Apply for this param from this client returns ERR_GESTURE_ENDED until a new holdBegin (or holdEnd). Suggested UI text: 'Changed at the mixer: -10.0 dB'.

The hold was cancelled because the console went stale, the engine was stopped/paused or (v0.1) the console stopped sending updates (limited). No write resumes when the status returns to live: the UI must send a new holdBegin.

v0.1 (design SR-15, CR-03). The console has no scene-recall message (x32: X32-F60; xair: XA section 7), so the core infers it: a burst of at least 8 different parameters pushed within 250 ms, and pushes of the console's scene markers if it sends them (x32: /-undo/time, /-show/prepos/current; xair, v0.2: /-snap/index, a hint only; whether either console sends them is unverified). Every held fader has ended (externalChangeOnHeld events in the same message) and the core re-reads the console in the background. Suggested UI text: 'Scene recalled at the mixer' (high or medium), or nothing beyond the per-fader messages (low). The core never loads, saves or deletes a scene or snapshot itself: there is no such command in this contract (xair slot 64 may hold another app's data, XA-F63).

confidence.description: high: a burst and the console's recall marker (x32: the undo checkpoint /-undo/time); medium: that marker alone; low: a burst alone (another app changing many parameters at once looks the same). Hints never raise the event and never raise the confidence: the x32 highlighted scene and the xair snapshot index (/-snap/index is 'recently loaded/saved', XA-F60, so a save moves it too). On xair every recall is low until hardware shows more (xair.md test item 13).

signals.description: snapshotIndex is v0.2 (xair: /-snap/index was pushed within 1 s of the burst; a hint, like highlightedScene).

highlightedScene.description: Present when the console pushed /-show/prepos/current: the scene (or cue/snippet, per the console's show-control setting) HIGHLIGHTED on its scenes page, not necessarily the one loaded (X32-F61). Show it as a hint only.

loadedScene.description: v0.2, xair only. Present when the console pushed /-snap/index within 1 s of the burst that raised this event: the snapshot it reports as recently loaded or saved (XA-F60, 1..64). A lone /-snap/index push (for example after a save in another app) raises no event. Show it as a hint: 'Snapshot 12 at the mixer'.

events.description: Events report holds that ended without the user releasing them and (v0.1) scene recalls detected at the console. They appear in snapshots and diffs and are never dropped by coalescing (up to 256 between two messages).

muteGroups.description: v0.1, snapshot only: every mute group of the console; mute true = engaged. Changes arrive in diffs as param {strip: {kind: muteGroup, index}, field: mute}. Absent when the console has none (or did not answer for them).

dcas.description: v0.1, snapshot only: every DCA group; mute true = DCA muted.
